description.value: The fragment has enough continuity now to answer to a name. Your Ghost-Rig becomes immune to fear effects, gains resistance 10 (from its scavenged plating, extending to precision damage), and can take a reaction of its own once per round (a Static Discharge slam dealing 3d6+7 damage, or an intercepting body-block) even on a turn you don't spend commanding it. It can manage three or four words of broken speech.

cinderfall.incomplete: [RIG-NO-ACTOR] -- every clause targets a companion actor that doesn't exist in this corpus's Foundry pipeline (bucket 4: cross-creature effect from the holder's own passive; no selector for "your uninstantiated companion" exists anywhere in pf2e-source).
cinderfall.notSpell: scrapwright's class document carries system.spellcasting 0, so this is an ability, not a spell, and convert_class_spells.py declines it by design as a NON_CASTERS owner
